t: Annual Veterans Day recognition program hosted by West Side Middle School
s: Elkhart's West Side Middle School kept up its yearly tradition of honoring local veterans, with the Elkhart High School Air Force ROTC honor guard presenting the colors, music and a keynote from First Sergeant Willie Brown. Teachers say the program helps students connect what they learn in class with the people who served.

t: Middlebury Food Pantry hands out 100 turkeys on Veterans Day
s: Neighbors lined up early on Veterans Day as the Middlebury Food Pantry gave away 100 turkeys in a drive-through, part of the Food Bank of Northern Indiana's Turkeys on the Table drive. The pantry serves more than a thousand people a month, and the food bank's match means a $20 gift puts a holiday turkey on two families' tables.

t: Toys for Tots softball tournament marks 15th year in South Bend
s: Fifty-two teams spent the weekend at the Byers Softball Complex playing for toys, with every player bringing new, unwrapped gifts for children in need at Christmas. After fifteen years the tournament is closing in on a quarter of a million dollars raised, and a holiday-sweater tournament in Elkhart on 21 November keeps it going.
